sample_unit: melanoma patients who underwent sentinel node biopsy

links.outcome: Comparison of nomograms versus public AI platforms for predicting sentinel node positivity on same patients
links.effect: Only MSKCC nomogram (P=0.04) and ChatGPT (P=0.02) differed between positive and negative SNB; ChatGPT AUC 0.702, adding MSKCC gave 0.715. No concordance among nomograms or among AI platforms (P<0.001).
links.quote: Only ChatGPT score was statistically significant for SNB positivity after univariate logistic regression (odds ratio: 1.05; 95% confidence interval: 1.004-1.108; P = 0.03).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing existing public AI platforms (including ChatGPT) against traditional nomograms for predicting sentinel lymph node positivity in melanoma patients.
